edit.description: the pair's section half becomes a resolved arm, not context; the doc comment's contrary paragraph goes with it
the headings-and-bolded-bullet-leads read the arm resolves against

summary: The comment-citation pin resolves the italicized section half of a (`page.md`, *Section*) pair, exact after backtick normalization

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

acceptance: A comment citing a section its page no longer heads reds, and every pair spelling left on the tree resolves.
tests: a comment's (`page.md`, *Section*) pair resolves its section half against the page's headings and bolded bullet leads
an abbreviated section half is reported unresolved rather than matched as a prefix
notes: Roughly 300 pair sites on the tree; about 12 spellings across ~14 modules resolve to nothing under the exact rule and are this entry's to expand (*Derived state is computed*, *Routing rule*, *Bay discovery*, ...). The helper's own doc comment illustrates the shape with (`spec/loop.md`, *Section*), which the arm reds. Scope is comments, per the predicate's framing — not page prose. Files under-declared deliberately: the drift fixes are comment-only and too wide to declare.

edit.description: the `§ N` arm beside the fragment arm, off the same heading reader

summary: A `§ N` cross-reference on a docs page resolves against that page's own numbered headings, and is prose on a page that has none

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

acceptance: A renumbered docs section cannot leave a `§ N` on its own page standing, and a page with no numbered headings is silent rather than red.
tests: a `§ N` on a docs page resolves against that page's own numbered headings
a docs page with no numbered headings leaves its `§ N` as prose
notes: Ten docs pages carry numbered headings and `§ N` refs; CLI.md, INTENT.md and LAYERS.md carry none and take the prose arm (LAYERS.md's one ref names another page's § 6). Two refs on the tree aim at a *different* page's numbering — MIGRATING-0.11.md's `§ 3` and CASCADE-DRY-RUN.md's `v0.8 §4` — and are judged against their own page like every other, which is the reading the rule states.

edit.description: wake, sleep, stop and render gain a 74 row; the five pages that carry one name the discovery read too
the same four verb sections, which state their ranges in prose

summary: Every subcommand's --help names EX_IOERR and the files that reach it, the state root at discovery included

per.section: Exit codes — the run never lies to CI

acceptance: No subcommand page omits the code its own process can return, and the pin holds for a verb added later.
tests: docs/CLI.md's wake, sleep, stop and render sections name exit 74
notes: Bay discovery (`resolveRepoRoot`, top of `main`) returns 74 for every verb, so the four silent pages — wake, sleep, stop, render — already understate their range, and the four docs sections state exit ranges that omit it outright. Blocked on the tick entry only because the first pin reads every page, tick's included.
